Prefix sum construction — element-indexed

Given an array `arr`, construct an array `prefix` where each element in `prefix` stores the sum of all preceding elements in `arr` up to and including that index.

Prefix sum construction — boundary-indexed

Given an array `arr`, construct an array `prefix` where each element in `prefix` stores the sum of all preceding elements in `arr` up to but not including that index.

Suffix sum construction — element-indexed

Given an array `arr`, construct an array `suffix` where each element in `suffix` stores the sum of all elements in `arr` from the end of the array up and including that index.

Suffix sum construction — boundary-indexed

Given an array `arr`, construct an array `suffix` where each element in `suffix` stores the sum of all elements in `arr` from the end of the array up but not including that index.

Prefix maximum construction

Given an array `arr`, construct an array `prefix` where each element in `prefix` stores the maximum value of all preceding elements in `arr` up to and including that index.

Suffix maximum construction

Given an array `arr`, construct an array `suffix` where each element in `suffix` stores the maximum value of all elements in `arr` from the end of the array up and including that index.
